unit_files.dotfiles-sway-helper@waybar.service:
[Unit]
Description=Dotfiles Sway owned helper (%i)
PartOf=dotfiles-sway-session.target
BindsTo=dotfiles-sway-session.target
After=dotfiles-sway-session.target

[Service]
Type=exec
EnvironmentFile=%t/dotfiles-sway-session/environment
# start renders runtime instance files with a direct, resolved tool ExecStart.
# This unconfigured template must never launch a tool with implicit defaults.
ExecStart="@ROOT@/bin/waybar" "--config" "@ROOT@/configuration/waybar/config.jsonc" "--style" "@ROOT@/configuration/styles/waybar.css"
TimeoutStopSec=5
# Also reaps child writers/watchers; no user-wide process matching or killing.
KillMode=control-group
TasksAccounting=yes
SendSIGKILL=yes
Restart=no
